instruction: I sometimes accidentally press keys. Can you enable slow keys so the system waits a moment before registering keypresses?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: SLOW_KEYS=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard slow-keys-enable 2>/dev/null | grep -c true); if [ "$SLOW_KEYS" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Slow keys enabled"; else echo "Slow keys not enabled"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling slow keys via Settings > Accessibility > Typing Assist > Slow Keys. Evaluator checks slow-keys-enable setting. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.
